card.name: Fetal harm warnings, just before pregnancy terms
card.fires_on: The word after a drug name in a fetal toxicity heading (such as tablets), and the space before a pregnancy week number (about 20 weeks, about 30 weeks) in NSAID pregnancy warnings.

modes.label: Drug name before fetal harm
modes.description: The last part of a drug name or the word tablets, right before the phrase can cause fetal harm.

modes.description: The gap after about, just before a number of weeks of pregnancy.

card.plain: It fires in pregnancy warnings, at the spot just before fetal harm or a week count is stated.
